title: Twelve Monkeys Tropika Shorfill 100ml E-Liquid
description: Tropika by Twelve Monkeys delivers a vibrant mix of tropical fruit flavours, carefully blended to create a rich, smooth yet deliciously complex flavour experience. Bursting with layers of exotic fruits, this e-liquid balances sweet, juicy notes with a refreshing tropical finish, making it an excellent choice for fruit lovers seeking a well-rounded flavour profile. Designed with a high-VG 70VG/30PG ratio, Tropika is perfect for Sub-Ohm vape kits and high-powered DTL (direct-to-lung) devices, ensuring dense vapour production and full-bodied flavour. Supplied in a 100ml shortfill bottle with space for two 10ml nicotine shots, this e-liquid allows vapers to customise their nicotine strength to suit their preference. Twelve Monkeys is an award-winning Canadian e-liquid brand known for its masterful fruit blends, offering expertly crafted flavours with high-quality ingredients for a premium vaping experience.
